podcast.title: Re-recording after Northern Soul Popularity (1973)
podcast.body: After British club DJ Richard Seerling began playing her original B-side "Tainted Love" to great success in Northern Soul clubs, Gloria Jones re-recorded the song in 1973, but this new version also failed to gain traction. "Word got back to Gloria Jones who re-recorded the song and it failed again."

podcast.title: Involved in Marc Bolan's Death (September 16, 1977)
podcast.body: Gloria Jones was Mark Bolan's girlfriend and was driving the Mini Cooper when it crashed into a tree in southwest London on September 16, 1977, resulting in Bolan's death. "his girlfriend Gloria Jones drove their mini-cooper into a tree in southwest London."

podcast.title: Involvement in Mark Bolan's Death (1977)
podcast.body: On September 16, 1977, Gloria Jones was driving Mark Bolan's Mini home from a night out when she lost control of the car over a small bridge, hitting a fence post and a tree, which instantly killed Bolan. "This was all fine until September 16, 1977, when she was driving Bowlin's mini home from a night out and something went wrong over a small bridge and the car went out of control, hit a fence post and then a tree."

xref.title: Death in Car Accident (1977)
xref.body: Mark Bolan, a famous British glam musician and friend of David Bowie, was killed instantly on September 16, 1977, when the Mini he owned, driven by his girlfriend Gloria Jones, crashed. Bolan never learned to drive because he feared dying in a car accident. He had other, larger cars available, including a Rolls-Royce he had lent out to another band that night. "Mark Bowlin was killed instantly."
